<details class="nhsuk-details">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">Text description of this diagram</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

| Order | From | To | Phase | What is handed over |
|---|--------------|--------------|-------------|--------------------------|
| 1 | Commissioner | Analyst | Engagement and scoping | The decision, the deadline, and how certain the answer has to be |
| 2 | Analyst | Critical friend | Design | The design and plan, with the critical friend named on it |
| 3 | Critical friend | Analyst | Analysis | Findings, which are the analyst's to act on |
| 4 | Analyst | Commissioner | Delivery and sign-off | Draft results, so they are understood before sign-off |
| 5 | Analyst | Analysis Senior Responsible Officer | Delivery and sign-off | The assurance evidence |
| 6 | Critical friend | Analysis Senior Responsible Officer | Delivery and sign-off | Lead Assurer sign-off, which comes before the approval |
| 7 | Analysis Senior Responsible Officer | Commissioner | Delivery and sign-off | Approved as fit for its intended use |

: The seven handoffs: who passes what to whom, and in which phase

</div>
</details>
